roadmap.title: General progress and map objectives
roadmap.description: Earn battle pass tiers, complete challenges, and work on map objectives as you play. The time estimate covers active play and varies widely with skill. Full completion is currently blocked by unavailable Archives missions.

roadmap.title: Hero achievements
roadmap.description: Work through each hero's achievements in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Keep achievements that require one life, one match, or one ability activation separate when planning attempts.

roadmap.title: Arcade and seasonal modes
roadmap.description: Use Arcade Assault Maps for Lockdown and Double Cap. Work on Capture the Flag and Bounty Hunter when offered, and seasonal modes when they return. Waiting for modes is outside the active-play estimate.

roadmap.title: Unavailable Archives missions
roadmap.description: Uprising, Retribution, Storm Rising, and their Archives challenge missions are unavailable. Their entries retain the unlock requirements for a possible return; a new account cannot currently finish the full Steam list.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies with a single use of Reaper's Death Blossom in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 4 enemies with one Death Blossom as Reaper.

steps.text: As @npc{Reaper}, activate @mechanic{Death Blossom} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Kill 4 enemies with that single activation.

achievements.description: Win 100 games in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 100 wins in Quick Play or Competitive Play.

steps.text: Win 100 matches across @mechanic{Quick Play} and @mechanic{Competitive Play}.

achievements.description: Earn 10 battle pass tiers.
achievements.summary: Gain 10 battle pass tiers.

steps.text: Earn battle pass XP until you have gained 10 @mechanic{battle pass tiers}.

achievements.description: Earn 25 battle pass tiers.
achievements.summary: Gain 25 battle pass tiers.

steps.text: Earn battle pass XP until you have gained 25 @mechanic{battle pass tiers}.

achievements.description: Earn 50 battle pass tiers.
achievements.summary: Gain 50 battle pass tiers.

steps.text: Earn battle pass XP until you have gained 50 @mechanic{battle pass tiers}.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies with a single use of Genji's Dragonblade in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 4 enemies with one activation of Genji's Dragonblade.

steps.text: As @npc{Genji}, activate @mechanic{Dragonblade} in Quick Play or Competitive Play and use that activation to kill 4 enemies.

achievements.description: Get a 20 player kill streak in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, reach a 20-player kill streak.

steps.text: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, build your kill streak to 20 players without being killed.

achievements.description: Destroy 3 of Symmetra's Teleporters in a single Quick or Competitive Play game.
achievements.summary: In one Quick Play or Competitive Play match, destroy 3 enemy Symmetra Teleporters.

steps.text: Destroy 3 @npc{Symmetra} @mechanic{Teleporters} during one Quick Play or Competitive Play match.

achievements.description: Use health packs to heal 900 health in a single life in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, restore 900 health from health packs during one life.

steps.text: After taking damage in Quick Play or Competitive Play, collect @item{health packs}. Recover a total of 900 health from packs without dying.

achievements.description: Complete 50 challenges.
achievements.summary: Finish 50 challenges.

steps.text: Complete tasks listed in the @mechanic{Challenges} menu until your total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Earn 21 endorsements.
achievements.summary: Receive 21 endorsements.

steps.text: Play matches and receive a total of 21 @mechanic{endorsements} from other players.

achievements.description: Collect 50 unlocks for a single hero.
achievements.summary: Own 50 unlocks for one hero.

steps.text: Collect 50 @item{unlocks} belonging to the same hero; progress spread across different heroes does not meet the requirement.

achievements.description: Kill 2 enemies with a single use of Genji's Deflection in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use Genji's Deflection to kill 2 enemies within one activation.

steps.text: As @npc{Genji}, use @mechanic{Deflection} against enemy attacks in Quick Play or Competitive Play. The reflected attacks must kill 2 enemies during that activation.

achievements.description: Get 3 solo kills with a single clip of Reaper's shotguns in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, earn 3 solo kills from one clip of Reaper's shotguns.

steps.text: As @npc{Reaper}, get 3 @mechanic{solo kills} in Quick Play or Competitive Play using the same clip of shotgun ammunition. Do not reload between those kills.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy that is hindered by Flashbang with a headshot as Cassidy in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, headshot-kill an enemy hindered by Cassidy's Flashbang.

steps.text: As @npc{Cassidy}, hit an enemy with @mechanic{Flashbang} in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Kill that enemy with a headshot while the Flashbang's @mechanic{Hindered} effect is active.

achievements.description: Get 4 killing blows with a single use of Cassidy's Deadeye in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, land 4 killing blows during one Deadeye as Cassidy.

steps.text: As @npc{Cassidy}, use @mechanic{Deadeye} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Kill 4 enemies with that single activation.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies in a row without touching the ground as Pharah in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 4 enemies consecutively as Pharah without landing.

steps.text: As @npc{Pharah}, stay airborne in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Kill 4 enemies in succession before touching the ground.

achievements.description: Knock an enemy to their death using Pharah's Concussive Blast in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, cause an enemy's environmental death with Pharah's Concussive Blast.

steps.text: As @npc{Pharah}, use @mechanic{Concussive Blast} to knock an enemy off an edge to their death in Quick Play or Competitive Play.

achievements.description: Get 2 killing blows with a single use of Soldier: 76's Helix Rockets in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, land 2 killing blows with one Helix Rockets volley as Soldier: 76.

steps.text: As @npc{Soldier: 76}, fire @mechanic{Helix Rockets} at enemies in Quick Play or Competitive Play. The same volley must deliver 2 final blows.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies with a single use of Soldier: 76's Tactical Visor in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 4 enemies with one activation of Soldier: 76's Tactical Visor.

steps.text: As @npc{Soldier: 76}, activate @mechanic{Tactical Visor} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Kill 4 enemies with that single use.

achievements.description: Recover 400 health using Tracer's Recall without dying in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, restore 400 health through Tracer's Recall during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Tracer}, recover damage with @mechanic{Recall} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Restore 400 health in total before dying.

achievements.description: Stick 4 of Tracer's Pulse Bombs onto enemies in a single Quick or Competitive Play game.
achievements.summary: In one Quick Play or Competitive Play match, stick 4 Pulse Bombs to enemies as Tracer.

steps.text: As @npc{Tracer}, attach @mechanic{Pulse Bomb} directly to enemy players 4 times during one Quick Play or Competitive Play match.

achievements.description: Kill 2 enemies in each of Bastion's configurations without dying in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, get 2 kills per configuration as Bastion across all 3 configurations during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Bastion}, get 2 kills in @mechanic{Configuration: Recon} and 2 in @mechanic{Configuration: Assault} in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Also kill 2 enemies with @mechanic{Configuration: Artillery}, keeping the same life through all 6 kills.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with a single use of Bastion's Configuration: Artillery in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 3 enemies with one activation of Bastion's Configuration: Artillery.

steps.text: Use @npc{Bastion}'s @mechanic{Configuration: Artillery} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Kill 3 enemies during that activation.

achievements.description: Get 3 killing blows with a single use of Hanzo's Storm Arrows in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, land 3 killing blows with one activation of Hanzo's Storm Arrows.

steps.text: As @npc{Hanzo}, activate @mechanic{Storm Arrows} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Secure 3 final blows before that activation is spent.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies with one of Hanzo's Spirit Dragons in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 4 enemies with one Spirit Dragon as Hanzo.

steps.text: As @npc{Hanzo}, use @mechanic{Dragonstrike} in Quick Play or Competitive Play so one Spirit Dragon kills 4 enemies.

achievements.description: Knock an enemy into your Steel Trap using Junkrat's Concussion Mine in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, knock an enemy into Junkrat's Steel Trap using Concussion Mine.

steps.text: As @npc{Junkrat}, place @mechanic{Steel Trap} in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Detonate @mechanic{Concussion Mine} so its knockback sends an enemy into the trap.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies with a single use of Junkrat's RIP-Tire in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 4 enemies with one RIP-Tire as Junkrat.

steps.text: As @npc{Junkrat}, detonate @mechanic{RIP-Tire} in Quick Play or Competitive Play so that explosion kills 4 enemies.

achievements.description: Block 1000 damage with a single use of Mei's Ice Wall in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use one Ice Wall as Mei to block 1000 damage.

steps.text: As @npc{Mei}, place @mechanic{Ice Wall} against incoming fire in Quick Play or Competitive Play. That wall must block 1000 damage.

achievements.description: Freeze 4 enemies at once with Mei in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, freeze 4 enemies simultaneously as Mei.

steps.text: As @npc{Mei}, use @mechanic{Blizzard} on a group in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Keep 4 enemies inside its area until all 4 are frozen at once.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies during a single use of Torbjörn's Molten Core in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 4 enemies during one Molten Core as Torbjörn.

steps.text: As @npc{Torbjörn}, activate @mechanic{Molten Core} in Quick Play or Competitive Play and kill 4 enemies during the same activation.

achievements.description: Absorb 500 damage with Torbjörn's Overload without dying in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use Torbjörn's Overload to absorb 500 damage during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Torbjörn}, absorb damage with @mechanic{Overload} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Reach 500 damage absorbed before dying.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies using Widowmaker's Venom Mine during a single Quick or Competitive Play game.
achievements.summary: In one Quick Play or Competitive Play match, use Widowmaker's Venom Mine to kill 4 enemies.

steps.text: As @npc{Widowmaker}, use @mechanic{Venom Mine} to kill 4 enemies during one Quick Play or Competitive Play match.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a scoped headshot while airborne as Widowmaker in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, headshot-kill an enemy through Widowmaker's scope while airborne.

steps.text: As @npc{Widowmaker}, aim through your scope while in the air in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Land a lethal headshot before touching the ground.

achievements.description: Prevent 1250 damage with a single use of D.va's Defense Matrix in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, prevent 1250 damage with one activation of D.Va's Defense Matrix.

steps.text: As @npc{D.Va}, use @mechanic{Defense Matrix} against incoming attacks in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Prevent 1250 damage before ending that activation.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies with a single use of D.va's Self Destruct in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 4 enemies with one Self-Destruct as D.Va.

steps.text: Activate @npc{D.Va}'s @mechanic{Self-Destruct} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. The explosion must kill 4 enemies.

achievements.description: Block 7500 damage with Reinhardt's Barrier Field without dying in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use Reinhardt's Barrier Field to block 7500 damage during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Reinhardt}, block attacks with @mechanic{Barrier Field} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Reach 7500 blocked damage without being killed.

achievements.description: Land Reinhardt's Fire Strike and Charge after an Earthshatter stun in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, hit an enemy with Reinhardt's Fire Strike and Charge following an Earthshatter stun.

steps.text: As @npc{Reinhardt}, stun an enemy with @mechanic{Earthshatter} in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Follow the stun with @mechanic{Fire Strike}, then @mechanic{Charge}, landing both attacks.

achievements.description: Interrupt an enemy ultimate ability with Roadhog's Hook in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, stop an enemy ultimate with Roadhog's Hook.

steps.text: As @npc{Roadhog}, hit an enemy with @mechanic{Hook} while they are using an interruptible ultimate in Quick Play or Competitive Play.

achievements.description: Knock 2 enemies to their deaths with one use of Roadhog's Whole Hog in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, cause 2 environmental kills during one use of Roadhog's Whole Hog.

steps.text: Use @npc{Roadhog}'s @mechanic{Whole Hog} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Push 2 enemies off an edge to their deaths during that activation.

achievements.description: Destroy 10 turrets or traps using Winston's Tesla Cannon without dying in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, destroy 10 turrets or traps with Winston's Tesla Cannon during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Winston}, destroy enemy turrets and traps with @mechanic{Tesla Cannon} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Destroy 10 in total before dying.

achievements.description: Damage 5 enemies during a single use of Winston's Primal Rage in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, damage 5 enemies during one Primal Rage as Winston.

steps.text: As @npc{Winston}, activate @mechanic{Primal Rage} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Hit 5 different enemies before that activation ends.

achievements.description: Keep Zarya's particle cannon above 70 power for 60 seconds in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, keep Zarya's Particle Cannon power above 70 for 60 consecutive seconds.

steps.text: As @npc{Zarya}, use your barriers to absorb enemy damage and raise @mechanic{Energy} in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Keep gaining Energy as needed so the Particle Cannon stays strictly above 70 power for a full minute.

achievements.description: Capture 4 enemies in a single use of Zarya's Graviton Surge in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, trap 4 enemies with one Graviton Surge as Zarya.

steps.text: As @npc{Zarya}, use @mechanic{Graviton Surge} in Quick Play or Competitive Play so its area captures 4 enemies.

achievements.description: Get 3 killing blows while wall riding as Lúcio without dying in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, wall ride as Lúcio when landing 3 killing blows during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Lúcio}, stay on a wall with @mechanic{Wall Ride} when you deliver a killing blow in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Get 3 such final blows before dying.

achievements.description: Block 900 damage with a single use of Lúcio's Sound Barrier in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, block 900 damage with one Sound Barrier as Lúcio.

steps.text: As @npc{Lúcio}, use @mechanic{Sound Barrier} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. The shields from that activation must block 900 damage.

achievements.description: Restore 150 health for 4 allies without dying as Mercy in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, restore 150 health to each of 4 allies as Mercy during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Mercy}, heal 4 different teammates for at least 150 health each in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Stay alive until you have healed the fourth teammate enough.

achievements.description: Resurrect 5 allies without dying as Mercy in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, resurrect 5 allies as Mercy during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Mercy}, successfully use @mechanic{Resurrect} on fallen teammates 5 times in Quick Play or Competitive Play without being killed.

achievements.description: Hit an enemy with 3 beams simultaneously as Symmetra in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, hit one enemy with 3 simultaneous beams as Symmetra.

steps.text: As @npc{Symmetra}, place 3 @mechanic{Sentry Turrets} with overlapping coverage in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Have all 3 beams hit the same enemy at once.

achievements.description: Teleport 15 allies in a single Quick or Competitive Play game as Symmetra.
achievements.summary: In one Quick Play or Competitive Play match, teleport 15 allies as Symmetra.

steps.text: As @npc{Symmetra}, place @mechanic{Teleporter} for your teammates in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Have allies use it 15 times within the same match.

achievements.description: Get 4 kills or assists with Zenyatta's Orb of Discord within 6 seconds in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use Zenyatta's Orb of Discord to earn 4 kills or assists within a 6-second window.

steps.text: As @npc{Zenyatta}, apply @mechanic{Orb of Discord} to enemies in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Move Discord between targets as they die so you receive 4 Discord kills or assists in a 6-second window.

achievements.description: Restore 1250 health with a single use of Zenyatta's Transcendence in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use one Transcendence as Zenyatta to restore 1250 health.

steps.text: As @npc{Zenyatta}, activate @mechanic{Transcendence} near injured allies in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Heal 1250 health before that activation ends.

achievements.description: Win a game of Assault Maps on defense without losing the first objective.
achievements.summary: Win an Assault Maps match on defense while keeping the first objective uncaptured.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Arcade} and select @mechanic{Assault Maps} when offered.
On defense, win the match without allowing the attackers to capture the first point.

achievements.description: Capture both objectives on a game of Assault Maps without dying.
achievements.summary: Capture both objectives in one Assault Maps match during one life.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Assault Maps} in Arcade when offered.
On attack, help capture the first and second objectives without dying between the start of the attempt and the second capture.

achievements.description: Push a payload 100 meters without leaving it in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, stay with the payload for 100 uninterrupted meters of pushing.

steps.text: While attacking in Quick Play or Competitive Play, stay within the payload's escort range until it has moved 100 meters without you leaving it.

achievements.description: Prevent the attacking team from touching the payload for 1 minute in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, deny the attackers any payload contact for 1 minute.

steps.text: On payload defense in Quick Play or Competitive Play, keep every attacker away from the payload for a continuous minute.

achievements.description: Win a Control map without the enemy capturing an objective in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, win a Control map without letting the enemy capture an objective.

steps.text: In a Quick Play or Competitive Play @mechanic{Control} match, win the map while denying the enemy every objective capture.

achievements.description: Win a Quick or Competitive Play game on 12 different maps.
achievements.summary: Win on 12 different maps in Quick Play or Competitive Play.

steps.text: Earn a victory on each of 12 distinct maps in @mechanic{Quick Play} or @mechanic{Competitive Play}.

achievements.description: Play a Quick or Competitive Play game in a group with a friend.
achievements.summary: Play a Quick Play or Competitive Play match while grouped with a friend.

steps.text: Join a group with a friend and play a @mechanic{Quick Play} or @mechanic{Competitive Play} match together.

achievements.description: Interrupt an enemy ultimate ability with Ana's Sleep Dart in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, stop an enemy ultimate with Ana's Sleep Dart.

steps.text: As @npc{Ana}, hit an enemy with @mechanic{Sleep Dart} while they use an interruptible ultimate in Quick Play or Competitive Play.

achievements.description: Get 4 kills or assists with a single use of Ana's Nano Boost in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, earn 4 kills or assists from one Nano Boost as Ana.

steps.text: As @npc{Ana}, use @mechanic{Nano Boost} on a teammate in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Earn 4 kills or assists during that activation.

achievements.description: Win Junkenstein's Revenge on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Junkenstein's Revenge on Hard difficulty.

guide.context: This mode is tied to @mechanic{Halloween Terror}.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Hard} in Junkenstein's Revenge when offered. Destroy Zomnics and Shock-Tires before they reach the gate.
Defend the gate through the final boss wave and win.

achievements.description: Win Junkenstein's Revenge on Hard difficulty with no damage to the door.
achievements.summary: Win Junkenstein's Revenge on Hard without the castle door taking damage.

guide.context: Zomnics and Shock-Tires can damage the gate; Zombardier shots cannot directly damage it.

steps.text: When Junkenstein's Revenge is available, choose @mechanic{Hard}. Destroy every Zomnic and Shock-Tire before they hit the gate.
Win the match while keeping the door undamaged throughout.

achievements.description: Win Junkenstein's Revenge with 4 different heroes.
achievements.summary: Win Junkenstein's Revenge as 4 different heroes.

guide.context: This mode is tied to @mechanic{Halloween Terror}.

steps.text: When @mechanic{Junkenstein's Revenge} is available, win a match with each of 4 distinct heroes.

achievements.description: Win Junkenstein's Revenge on Legendary difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Junkenstein's Revenge on Legendary difficulty.

guide.context: This mode is tied to @mechanic{Halloween Terror}.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Legendary} in Junkenstein's Revenge when the mode is available. Stop Zomnics and Shock-Tires before they hit the gate.
Keep defending the gate and defeat the final boss wave.

achievements.description: Hack 15 enemies without dying as Sombra in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, prevent lethal damage by weakening an enemy with Sombra's Cyberspace.

guide.context: Weaken reduces the affected enemy's damage output by 50%.

steps.text: As @npc{Sombra}, hit an enemy with @mechanic{Cyberspace} in Quick Play or Competitive Play so @mechanic{Weaken} prevents an otherwise lethal attack.

achievements.description: Hack 5 enemies at once as Sombra in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, hack 5 enemies simultaneously as Sombra.

steps.text: As @npc{Sombra}, use @mechanic{EMP} on a group of 5 enemies in Quick Play or Competitive Play so all 5 are hacked at once.

achievements.description: Win Mei's Snowball Offensive without losing a round.
achievements.summary: Win a Mei's Snowball Offensive match without dropping a round.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Mei's Snowball Offensive}, win every round of a match so the opposing team never earns a round victory.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies without missing in Mei's Snowball Offensive.
achievements.summary: In Mei's Snowball Offensive, kill 4 enemies without missing a shot.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Mei's Snowball Offensive}, land 4 lethal shots without firing a miss. Reload from snow piles between shots as needed.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a snowball from 25 meters away in Mei's Snowball Offensive.
achievements.summary: In Mei's Snowball Offensive, kill an enemy with a snowball fired from 25 meters away.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Mei's Snowball Offensive}, hit an enemy with a snowball from a distance of at least 25 meters.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies while they are picking up snow in a game of Mei's Snowball Offensive.
achievements.summary: In one Mei's Snowball Offensive match, kill 3 enemies while they gather snow.

steps.text: Watch snow piles in @mechanic{Mei's Snowball Offensive}. During one match, shoot 3 enemies while they are refilling their snowballs.

achievements.description: Win Capture the Flag with a score of 3 to 0.
achievements.summary: Win a Capture the Flag match 3–0.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Capture the Flag}, score 3 team captures while preventing the opposing team from scoring any captures.

achievements.description: Recover a flag in a game of Capture the Flag.
achievements.summary: Return your team's dropped flag in Capture the Flag.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Capture the Flag}, recover your team's flag after an enemy drops it.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with a single use of Orisa's Terra Surge in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill 3 enemies with one activation of Orisa's Terra Surge.

steps.text: As @npc{Orisa}, use @mechanic{Terra Surge} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Kill at least 3 enemies with that activation.

achievements.description: Knock an enemy to their death using Orisa's Energy Javelin in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, cause an enemy's environmental death with Orisa's Energy Javelin.

steps.text: As @npc{Orisa}, knock an enemy off an edge with @mechanic{Energy Javelin} in Quick Play or Competitive Play so the fall kills them.

achievements.description: Complete Uprising (Story) on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Story version of Uprising on Hard difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Uprising returns, select @mechanic{Story} on @mechanic{Hard}. Complete the mission's four stages with the team.

achievements.description: Complete Uprising (Story) on Expert difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Story version of Uprising on Expert difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Uprising returns, select @mechanic{Story} on @mechanic{Expert} and complete all four mission stages.

achievements.description: Complete Uprising (Story) on Legendary difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Story version of Uprising on Legendary difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Uprising returns, choose @mechanic{Story} on @mechanic{Legendary}. Work with the four-player team to finish every mission stage.

achievements.description: Deliver the payload with over 80% health in Uprising (Story) on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: In Uprising's Story version on Hard, deliver the payload with more than 80% of its health left.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Uprising returns, choose @mechanic{Story} on @mechanic{Hard}.
Protect the payload during the stationary defense and the following escort. Deliver it with health strictly above 80%.

achievements.description: Complete Uprising (Story) with each of the 4 heroes.
achievements.summary: Finish Uprising's Story version as each of its 4 heroes.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Uprising returns, finish @mechanic{Story} as @npc{Reinhardt}, @npc{Mercy}, @npc{Tracer}, and @npc{Torbjörn}, with one completion per hero.

achievements.description: Complete Uprising (All Heroes) with 8 different heroes.
achievements.summary: Finish Uprising's All Heroes version as 8 different heroes.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Uprising returns, choose @mechanic{All Heroes}. Finish the mission as 8 distinct heroes, changing your hero between completed runs.

achievements.description: Slam 3 enemies into a wall with Doomfist's Empowered Rocket Punch in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use one Empowered Rocket Punch as Doomfist to slam 3 enemies into a wall.

steps.text: As @npc{Doomfist}, use @mechanic{Power Block} against incoming damage in Quick Play or Competitive Play until your next punch becomes empowered.
Use that @mechanic{Empowered Rocket Punch} to knock 3 enemies into a wall.

achievements.description: Hit 4 enemies with a single use of Doomfist's Meteor Strike in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, hit 4 enemies with one Meteor Strike as Doomfist.

steps.text: Use @npc{Doomfist}'s @mechanic{Meteor Strike} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Land the strike on at least 4 enemies at once.

achievements.description: Score a goal in Lúcioball with a shot taken from at least 4 meters in the air.
achievements.summary: In Lúcioball, score from a shot taken at least 4 meters above the ground.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Lúcioball}, use a jump pad to gain height.
From a height of 4 meters or more, hit the ball into the opposing goal.

achievements.description: Score 3 saves in a row in Lúcioball.
achievements.summary: In Lúcioball, earn a streak of 3 saves.

steps.text: Defend your goal in @mechanic{Lúcioball}. Block 3 goal-bound shots in succession to receive 3 consecutive save credits.

achievements.description: Score a goal, a save, and an assist in a game of Lúcioball.
achievements.summary: In one Lúcioball match, score a goal and earn both an assist and a save.

steps.text: During one @mechanic{Lúcioball} match, score a goal, block a shot for a save, and set up a teammate's goal for an assist.

achievements.description: Win Junkenstein's Revenge on Expert difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Junkenstein's Revenge on Expert difficulty.

guide.context: This mode is tied to @mechanic{Halloween Terror}.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Expert} in Junkenstein's Revenge when the mode is available. Destroy Zomnics and Shock-Tires before they reach the castle gate.
Keep defending through the final boss wave and win the match.

achievements.description: Win Junkenstein Endless with 6 different heroes.
achievements.summary: Win Junkenstein Endless as 6 different heroes.

guide.context: Junkenstein Endless awards a win after its 12 regular waves; bonus waves follow afterward.

steps.text: When @mechanic{Junkenstein Endless} is available, finish the 12 regular waves with one hero.
Earn an Endless win with 5 other heroes, for 6 different heroes in total.

achievements.description: Win Junkenstein Endless on Hard difficulty with no damage to the door.
achievements.summary: Win Junkenstein Endless on Hard without the castle door taking damage.

guide.context: Endless has 12 regular waves before the bonus waves begin.

steps.text: When Junkenstein Endless is available, select @mechanic{Hard}. Destroy every Zomnic and Shock-Tire before they hit the door.
Finish the regular waves with the door still undamaged.

achievements.description: Survive 4 bonus waves in Junkenstein Endless on Expert difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Expert difficulty in Junkenstein Endless, survive through bonus wave 4.

guide.context: The bonus-wave counter starts after the 12 regular waves.

steps.text: When Junkenstein Endless is available, choose @mechanic{Expert} and survive the regular waves.
Keep defending until you have completed bonus wave 4.

achievements.description: Hit 6 targets simultaneously with Moira's Coalescence in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, hit 6 targets at the same time with Moira's Coalescence.

steps.text: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, aim @npc{Moira}'s @mechanic{Coalescence} through a line of players so 6 targets are hit at once.

achievements.description: Fully deplete both types of Moira's Biotic Orb without dying in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, exhaust a healing Biotic Orb and a damage Biotic Orb as Moira during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Moira}, use a healing @mechanic{Biotic Orb} until its healing supply runs out in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Also exhaust a damage Biotic Orb before dying; merely letting either orb expire is insufficient.

achievements.description: Eat 4 meat as the Yeti in Yeti Hunter.
achievements.summary: Eat 4 pieces of meat while playing the Yeti in Yeti Hunter.

steps.text: Play the @npc{Yeti} in @mechanic{Yeti Hunter}. Visit the meat spawns marked by fires and eat 4 pieces.

achievements.description: Trap the Yeti as a Hunter in Yeti Hunter.
achievements.summary: Catch the Yeti in a trap while playing a Hunter in Yeti Hunter.

steps.text: Play a @npc{Hunter} in @mechanic{Yeti Hunter}. Charge @mechanic{Yeti Trap} and place it at a meat spawn so the Yeti steps into it.

achievements.description: Kill an airborne enemy with Brigitte's Whip Shot in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use Brigitte's Whip Shot to kill an enemy who is airborne.

steps.text: As @npc{Brigitte}, land a lethal @mechanic{Whip Shot} on an enemy who is still airborne in Quick Play or Competitive Play.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy hero with Brigitte's Shield Bash in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, land a killing blow using Brigitte's Shield Bash.

steps.text: As @npc{Brigitte}, hit an enemy with @mechanic{Shield Bash} in Quick Play or Competitive Play so the bash delivers the killing blow.

achievements.description: Complete Retribution (Story) with each of the 4 heroes.
achievements.summary: Finish Retribution's Story version as each of its 4 heroes.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Retribution returns, finish @mechanic{Story} as @npc{Reaper}, @npc{Cassidy}, @npc{Genji}, and @npc{Moira}, with one completed mission per hero.

achievements.description: Complete Retribution (All Heroes) with 8 different heroes.
achievements.summary: Finish Retribution's All Heroes version as 8 different heroes.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Retribution returns, select @mechanic{All Heroes}. Complete the mission with each of 8 different heroes.

achievements.description: Complete Retribution (Story) on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Story version of Retribution on Hard difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Retribution returns, choose @mechanic{Story} on @mechanic{Hard}. Stay with the team and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Retribution (Story) on Expert difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Story version of Retribution on Expert difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Retribution returns, select its @mechanic{Story} version and @mechanic{Expert} difficulty. Keep the team together and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Retribution (Story) on Legendary difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Story version of Retribution on Legendary difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Retribution returns, choose @mechanic{Story} and @mechanic{Legendary}. Stay together so the team can focus on each special enemy and complete the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Retribution (Story) on Expert difficulty with no incapacitations.
achievements.summary: Finish Retribution's Story version on Expert with no team member incapacitated.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Retribution returns, choose @mechanic{Story} on @mechanic{Expert}. Keep every teammate from being downed throughout the mission.
Finish the mission with the entire team having avoided incapacitation.

achievements.description: Absorb 1250 damage with Wrecking Ball's Adaptive Shield without dying in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use Wrecking Ball's Adaptive Shield to absorb 1250 damage during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Wrecking Ball}, use @mechanic{Adaptive Shield} to absorb enemy damage in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Accumulate 1250 absorbed damage before dying.

achievements.description: Roll through 4 enemies within 2 seconds as Wrecking Ball in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, hit 4 enemies by rolling as Wrecking Ball within a 2-second window.

steps.text: As @npc{Wrecking Ball}, roll through a group of 4 enemies in Quick Play or Competitive Play. All 4 contacts must occur within a 2-second window.

achievements.description: Win Junkenstein's Revenge with 6 different heroes.
achievements.summary: Win Junkenstein's Revenge as 6 different heroes.

guide.context: This mode is tied to @mechanic{Halloween Terror}.

steps.text: Win @mechanic{Junkenstein's Revenge} once as each of 6 different heroes when the mode is available.

achievements.description: Survive 4 bonus waves in Junkenstein Endless on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: On Hard difficulty in Junkenstein Endless, survive through bonus wave 4.

guide.context: The bonus waves start after 12 regular waves.

steps.text: When Junkenstein Endless is available, choose @mechanic{Hard} and survive the regular waves.
Continue defending the gate through bonus wave 4.

achievements.description: Survive 12 bonus waves in Junkenstein Endless.
achievements.summary: In Junkenstein Endless, survive through bonus wave 12.

guide.context: The bonus-wave counter begins after the 12 regular waves.

steps.text: When @mechanic{Junkenstein Endless} is available, survive the regular waves.
Continue through 12 additional bonus waves; reaching regular wave 12 alone does not meet the requirement.

achievements.description: Get a killing blow as Ashe on an enemy knocked into the air by B.O.B. in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill an enemy as Ashe while B.O.B. has knocked that enemy airborne.

steps.text: As @npc{Ashe}, send @npc{B.O.B.} into an enemy in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Deliver the final blow yourself while the enemy is airborne from B.O.B.'s knock-up.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy by shooting Ashe’s Dynamite from at least 30 meters away in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, shoot Ashe's Dynamite from a distance of 30 meters or more so the Dynamite kills an enemy.

steps.text: As @npc{Ashe}, throw @mechanic{Dynamite} near an enemy in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
From at least 30 meters away, shoot the Dynamite so its damage kills the enemy.

achievements.description: Kill 2 enemies with a single use of Mei's Flurry in Mei's Snowball Offensive.
achievements.summary: In Mei's Snowball Offensive, kill 2 enemies during one Flurry.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Mei's Snowball Offensive}, activate @mechanic{Flurry}. Use its unlimited snowballs to kill 2 enemies before that activation ends.

achievements.description: Win a round as the sole survivor in Mei's Snowball Offensive.
achievements.summary: Win a round of Mei's Snowball Offensive as your team's only survivor.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Mei's Snowball Offensive}, win a round after all your teammates have been eliminated, while you remain alive.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies as the Yeti in Yeti Hunt.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies while playing the Yeti in Yeti Hunter.

steps.text: Play the @npc{Yeti} in @mechanic{Yeti Hunter}. Eat 4 pieces of meat; @mechanic{Primal Rage} activates automatically after the fourth piece. Attack the Hunters until you have killed 3.

achievements.description: Capture a flag in a game of Capture the Flag.
achievements.summary: Score a flag capture in Capture the Flag.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Capture the Flag}, take the enemy flag and return it to your team's capture point to score.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy as they carry the flag in a game of Capture the Flag.
achievements.summary: Kill the enemy flag carrier in Capture the Flag.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Capture the Flag}, kill an enemy before they stop carrying the flag.

achievements.description: Complete Storm Rising (Story) with each of the 4 heroes.
achievements.summary: Finish Storm Rising's Story version as each of its 4 heroes.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Storm Rising returns, finish @mechanic{Story} once as each of @npc{Tracer}, @npc{Genji}, @npc{Winston}, and @npc{Mercy}.

achievements.description: Complete Storm Rising (Story) on Expert difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Story version of Storm Rising on Expert difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Storm Rising returns, choose @mechanic{Story} on @mechanic{Expert}. Stay with the team and complete the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Storm Rising (Story) on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Story version of Storm Rising on Hard difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Storm Rising returns, select @mechanic{Story} and @mechanic{Hard}. Stay together and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Storm Rising (Story) on Legendary difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the Story version of Storm Rising on Legendary difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Storm Rising returns, select @mechanic{Story} and @mechanic{Legendary}. Keep the team together through the mission and finish it.

achievements.description: Complete Storm Rising (All Heroes) with 8 different heroes.
achievements.summary: Finish Storm Rising's All Heroes version as 8 different heroes.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Storm Rising returns, choose @mechanic{All Heroes}. Finish a mission as each of 8 different heroes.

achievements.description: Complete Storm Rising (All Heroes) on Expert difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the All Heroes version of Storm Rising on Expert difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Storm Rising returns, choose @mechanic{All Heroes} on @mechanic{Expert}. Bring a team with healing, shielding, and damage, then finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Storm Rising (All Heroes) on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the All Heroes version of Storm Rising on Hard difficulty.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Storm Rising returns, choose @mechanic{All Heroes} and @mechanic{Hard}. Complete the mission with the team.

achievements.description: Complete Storm Rising (All Heroes) on Legendary difficulty with no incapacitations.
achievements.summary: Finish Storm Rising's All Heroes version on Legendary with no team member incapacitated.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Storm Rising returns, choose @mechanic{All Heroes} on @mechanic{Legendary}. Use a team with healing, shielding, and damage.
Finish the mission without any teammate being downed.

achievements.description: Amplify 2000 combined damage and healing without dying as Baptiste in Quick or Competitive play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, amplify a combined 2000 damage and healing as Baptiste during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Baptiste}, place @mechanic{Amplification Matrix} where shots can pass through it in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Accumulate 2000 amplified damage and healing before dying, using additional matrices as needed.

achievements.description: Prevent 4 deaths with a single use of Baptiste's Immortality Field in Quick or Competitive play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, prevent 4 deaths with one Immortality Field as Baptiste.

steps.text: As @npc{Baptiste}, deploy @mechanic{Immortality Field} in Quick Play or Competitive Play so it prevents 4 deaths during that one field's lifetime.

achievements.description: Get 3 killing blows during a single use of Sigma's Gravitic Flux in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, score 3 killing blows within one activation of Sigma's Gravitic Flux.

steps.text: Use @npc{Sigma}'s @mechanic{Gravitic Flux} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Secure 3 final blows during the same activation; assists alone do not satisfy the requirement.

achievements.description: Gain 350 shields with a single use of Sigma's Kinetic Grasp in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, gain 350 shields from one activation of Sigma's Kinetic Grasp.

steps.text: Use @npc{Sigma}'s @mechanic{Kinetic Grasp} against incoming fire in Quick Play or Competitive Play. The single activation must grant at least 350 shields.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a charged Railgun headshot while sliding in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, kill an enemy with Sojourn's charged Railgun headshot during a slide.

steps.text: As @npc{Sojourn}, charge the @mechanic{Railgun} in Quick Play or Competitive Play.
Slide and land a lethal charged Railgun headshot before the slide ends.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy after destroying part of their Ice Wall in Snowball Deathmatch.
achievements.summary: In Snowball Deathmatch, destroy part of an enemy's Ice Wall and then kill that enemy.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Snowball Deathmatch}, break a section of an enemy Mei's @mechanic{Ice Wall}.
Kill the Mei who placed that wall.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies without reloading or dying in Snowball Deathmatch.
achievements.summary: In Snowball Deathmatch, kill 3 enemies before reloading or dying.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Snowball Deathmatch}. Land 3 lethal snowball shots without reloading or being killed between them.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a caught snowball in Snowball Deathmatch.
achievements.summary: In Snowball Deathmatch, kill an enemy using a snowball you caught.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Snowball Deathmatch}, catch an incoming snowball with @mechanic{Catch}.
Fire the caught snowball at an enemy and kill them.

achievements.description: Complete the Molten Cores Archives challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Archives challenge mission named Molten Cores.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Archives returns, select Uprising's @mechanic{Molten Cores} challenge. Fight from range and move away from the lava left by dead enemies, then finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the Glass Cannon Archives challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Archives challenge mission named Glass Cannon.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Archives returns, choose Uprising's @mechanic{Glass Cannon} challenge. Avoid rushing enemy groups with your reduced health and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the Surgical Strike Archives challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Archives challenge mission named Surgical Strike.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Archives returns, select Retribution's @mechanic{Surgical Strike} challenge. Aim for enemy heads and the Heavy Assault's red back tanks to deal damage, then finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the Close Quarters Archives challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Archives challenge mission named Close Quarters.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Archives returns, choose Retribution's @mechanic{Close Quarters} challenge. Keep a teammate near enemies to remove their damage immunity while the team attacks, then complete the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the Blood Moon Rising Archives challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Archives challenge mission named Blood Moon Rising.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Archives returns, select Storm Rising's @mechanic{Blood Moon Rising} challenge. Use the available Damage heroes, limit incoming damage, and complete the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the Storm Raging Archives challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Archives challenge mission named Storm Raging.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Archives returns, choose Storm Rising's @mechanic{Storm Raging} challenge. Clear nearby normal enemies before killing an enraged enemy so its enrage does not spread through the group, then finish the mission.

achievements.description: Earn 2 killing blows with a single use of Echo’s Focusing Beam in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, land 2 killing blows with one Focusing Beam as Echo.

steps.text: As @npc{Echo}, use @mechanic{Focusing Beam} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Kill 2 enemies before that activation ends.

achievements.description: Use 2 other heroes’ ultimates without dying as Echo in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use the ultimates of 2 other heroes as Echo during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Echo}, use @mechanic{Duplicate} on an enemy hero in Quick Play or Competitive Play, then charge and use the copied hero's ultimate.
Stay alive, duplicate a different enemy hero, and use that hero's ultimate too.

achievements.description: Score 2 goals within 5 seconds in a game of Lúcioball Remix.
achievements.summary: In Lúcioball Remix, score 2 goals within a 5-second window.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Lúcioball Remix}. Score twice with no more than 5 seconds between the two goals.

achievements.description: Earn 15 saves in a game of Lúcioball Remix.
achievements.summary: In one Lúcioball Remix match, earn 15 saves.

steps.text: Defend the goal in @mechanic{Lúcioball Remix}. Earn 15 save credits before that match ends.

achievements.description: Complete the Vengeful Ghost Junkenstein challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Junkenstein challenge mission named Vengeful Ghost.

guide.context: The ghost cannot be killed and its aura hurts nearby players.

steps.text: When the @mechanic{Vengeful Ghost} Junkenstein challenge is offered, keep moving away from the ghost while fighting.
Defend the gate and finish the final wave without letting the ghost overwhelm the team.

achievements.description: Complete the Frenzied Stampede Junkenstein challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Junkenstein challenge mission named Frenzied Stampede.

guide.context: Zomnics and Zombardiers move faster in this challenge.

steps.text: When the @mechanic{Frenzied Stampede} Junkenstein challenge is offered, watch the gate closely while fighting bosses. Destroy fast-moving Zomnics before they slip past the team.
Defend through the final wave and win.

achievements.description: Complete the Three They Were Junkenstein challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Junkenstein challenge mission named Three They Were.

guide.context: The team has only 3 players, with increased attack damage.

steps.text: When the @mechanic{Three They Were} Junkenstein challenge is offered, keep all teammates healed while covering the gate.
Survive the boss waves and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the Volatile Zomnics Junkenstein challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Junkenstein challenge mission named Volatile Zomnics.

guide.context: Zomnics explode when they get close to a player.

steps.text: When the @mechanic{Volatile Zomnics} Junkenstein challenge is offered, fight at range near the gate so Zomnics do not reach you.
Keep the gate intact through the last wave and win.

achievements.description: Complete the Mystery Swap Junkenstein challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Junkenstein challenge mission named Mystery Swap.

guide.context: Forced hero changes retain your accumulated ultimate charge.

steps.text: When the @mechanic{Mystery Swap} Junkenstein challenge is offered, adapt to each forced hero change and use the new hero's abilities to defend the gate.
Finish the final wave and win.

achievements.description: Complete the Shocking Surprise Junkenstein challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Junkenstein challenge mission named Shocking Surprise.

guide.context: Extra Shock-Tires can arrive without the usual spoken warnings.

steps.text: When the @mechanic{Shocking Surprise} Junkenstein challenge is offered, watch every route to the gate and destroy approaching Shock-Tires.
Be ready for 2 more tires where each defeated boss stood. Defend the gate through the final wave.

achievements.description: Interrupt 3 enemy thaws in a round of Freezethaw Elimination.
achievements.summary: In one Freezethaw Elimination round, interrupt 3 enemy thaw attempts.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Freezethaw Elimination}, find an enemy standing near a frozen teammate to thaw them. Defeat the thawing enemy before the frozen player revives.
Stop 3 enemy thaw attempts this way within the same round.

achievements.description: Interrupt an enemy ultimate ability by freezing them in Freezethaw Elimination.
achievements.summary: In Freezethaw Elimination, stop an enemy ultimate by freezing its user.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Freezethaw Elimination}, defeat an enemy while their interruptible ultimate is active. Defeat freezes the enemy and stops the ultimate.

achievements.description: Thaw a player who previously thawed you in a round of Freezethaw Elimination.
achievements.summary: In one Freezethaw Elimination round, thaw a teammate who previously thawed you.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Freezethaw Elimination}, after a teammate thaws you, find that teammate if they become frozen in the same round.
Stand beside that frozen teammate until they thaw.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies without dying as the bounty target in Bounty Hunter.
achievements.summary: In Bounty Hunter, kill 3 enemies as the Bounty Target during one life.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Bounty Hunter}, become the @mechanic{Bounty Target} by getting the first kill or killing the current target.
While holding the bounty, kill 3 enemies without being killed.

achievements.description: Earn 8 bounties in a game of Bounty Hunter.
achievements.summary: Claim 8 bounties during one Bounty Hunter match.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Bounty Hunter}, kill the current @mechanic{Bounty Target} to claim a bounty. Claim 8 bounties before the match ends.

achievements.description: Kill the Bounty Target while they are using an ultimate ability in Bounty Hunter
achievements.summary: In Bounty Hunter, kill the Bounty Target while their ultimate is active.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Bounty Hunter}, wait for the current @mechanic{Bounty Target} to use an ultimate. Kill that target before the ultimate ends.

achievements.description: Complete the Thunderstorm Archives challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Archives challenge mission named Thunderstorm.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Archives returns, select Storm Rising's @mechanic{Thunderstorm} challenge. Attack from outside the enemies' damaging electric auras and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the Bulletproof Barriers Archives challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Archives challenge mission named Bulletproof Barriers.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Archives returns, select Uprising's @mechanic{Bulletproof Barriers} challenge. Move around the unbreakable enemy shields to attack their owners, then complete the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the Sympathy Gains Archives challenge mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Archives challenge mission named Sympathy Gains.

guide.context: @warn{Archives missions are unavailable in the current game.}

steps.text: If Archives returns, choose Retribution's @mechanic{Sympathy Gains} challenge. Focus the team's attacks on one enemy at a time because damaging one enemy heals nearby enemies, then finish the mission.

achievements.description: Cleanse 5 negative effects with one use of Kiriko's Protection Suzu in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, remove 5 negative effects with one Protection Suzu as Kiriko.

steps.text: As @npc{Kiriko}, throw @mechanic{Protection Suzu} in Quick Play or Competitive Play so the same use removes at least 5 negative effects.

achievements.description: Restore 1500 health and land 5 critical hits without dying as Kiriko in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, land 5 critical hits and restore 1500 health as Kiriko during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Kiriko}, land 5 critical hits and heal a total of 1500 health in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Stay alive until both totals are reached.

achievements.description: Get 4 killing blows with a single use of Sojourn's Overclock in Quick or Competitive play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, land 4 killing blows during one Overclock as Sojourn.

steps.text: As @npc{Sojourn}, activate @mechanic{Overclock} in Quick Play or Competitive Play and secure 4 final blows before that activation ends.

achievements.description: Have 7 of Junker Queen's wounds active on enemies at the same time in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, keep 7 Junker Queen wounds active on enemies simultaneously.

guide.context: Different wound abilities can overlap on one enemy; reapplying the same wound type refreshes its duration.

steps.text: Start a Quick Play or Competitive Play match as another hero, then switch to @npc{Junker Queen} to avoid the wound-counter bug.
Combine @mechanic{Rampage}, @mechanic{Carnage}, and @mechanic{Jagged Blade} on enemies so at least 7 wounds overlap before the earlier wounds expire.

achievements.description: Use Junker Queen’s Jagged Blade and Carnage to pull and kill an enemy in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, pull an enemy with Junker Queen's Jagged Blade and kill that enemy with Carnage.

steps.text: As @npc{Junker Queen}, stick @mechanic{Jagged Blade} into an enemy in Quick Play or Competitive Play, then recall the blade to pull them toward you.
Hit the pulled enemy with @mechanic{Carnage} and kill them.

achievements.description: Eliminate 3 enemies in a single use of Ramattra's Annihilation in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, eliminate 3 enemies during one Annihilation as Ramattra.

steps.text: As @npc{Ramattra}, activate @mechanic{Annihilation} in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Earn 3 enemy eliminations during that activation.

achievements.description: Block 300 or more damage and survive in a single use of Nemesis Form in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, block at least 300 damage and survive one Nemesis Form activation as Ramattra.

steps.text: Start a Quick Play or Competitive Play match as another hero, then switch to @npc{Ramattra} to avoid the reported counter bug.
Enter @mechanic{Nemesis Form}, block 300 damage or more, and survive until that activation ends.

achievements.description: Restore 1200 health with a single use of Lifeweaver's Tree of Life in Quick or Competitive Play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, restore 1200 health with one Tree of Life as Lifeweaver.

steps.text: As @npc{Lifeweaver}, place @mechanic{Tree of Life} near injured allies in Quick Play or Competitive Play. That tree must restore a total of 1200 health.

achievements.description: Prevent 3 deaths using Lifeweaver's Life Grip without dying yourself in Quick or Competitive play.
achievements.summary: In Quick Play or Competitive Play, use Lifeweaver's Life Grip to prevent 3 deaths during one life.

steps.text: As @npc{Lifeweaver}, use @mechanic{Life Grip} to save allies from lethal danger in Quick Play or Competitive Play. Receive credit for 3 prevented deaths without being killed yourself.
